service.description: The organization and facility set a plan is for: the organization given, else the first facility's owner, else the user's active organization; the facilities given (each a warehouse or plant of the organization, netted with the facilities under it), else the plan schedule's, else the organization's top warehouses and plants.

Calculate the supply plan of an organization's facility set (one current run per organization and facility set; the last one is superseded, its unconverted suggestions ended and their requirements reused or rejected). Nets each product once, after its parents, at each facility with the facilities under it: open sales demand less its reservations (a kit's as its components'), each run's remaining WeptConsume and WeptProduce (drafts included; a kit assembly's shown, not netted), transfers in transit to it, open purchase order lines, available stock and the minimum stock, over the horizon. A shortage is a transfer from a facility of the set with a surplus, else a make suggestion with a released BOM (its components exploded through get#BomExplosion's requirements as the next level's demand, dated by the lead and preparation days), else a buy suggestion from a supplier price, else a NO_SOURCE exception; each is checked with check#ProductUsable (PRODUCT_NOT_USABLE). A runner without a method read (METHOD_VIEW) gets a made product's suggestion as a METHOD_INVALID exception. A product's reorder rule at a facility of the set (ProductFacility, R-PUR-19) orders up to its maximum stock (RdmUpToMaximum) or at least its reorder quantity (RdmFixedQuantity) once the projection falls below the minimum; a snoozed rule's shortage is still suggested, with the warning SNOOZED. The lines of a draft purchase order a conversion made are supply. Held stock is a pending-release line with its inspection's due date, netted only by the schedule's organization option for what is due within the lead time. Each suggestion stands on a Requirement of the organization (RequirementParty OrgInternal) in the stock unit. Requires SUPPLY_PLAN_RUN (PERMISSION_DENIED); refuses an organization or facility outside the user's (RECORD_UNAVAILABLE) and a horizon outside 1 to 730 days (PLAN_INVALID).

parameter.name: productIds
parameter.description: Plan these products (and their components) only; every product with demand when empty.

parameter.name: horizonDays
parameter.description: The schedule's, else the production policy's planning horizon when empty.

service.description: A supply plan as SupplyPlanning shows it: the run given, else the current run of the scope's facility set (none before the first), with its freshness (stale when superseded or older than the production policy's freshness limit); its suggestions (filtered by method, product or exceptions) with their requirement, covered and remaining quantity, supply links, dates, source and exception, and whether the user may convert each; the held lines pending release; the selected suggestion's demand and supply as of the run; and the organization's plan schedule. Requires SUPPLY_PLAN_RUN, SUPPLY_PLAN_VIEW, PRODUCTION_PLAN, PRODUCTION_VIEW or PURCHASE_ORDER_EDIT (a buyer); refuses an organization, facility or run outside the user's (RECORD_UNAVAILABLE).

parameter.name: planningSuggestionId
parameter.description: The suggestion whose demand and supply to explain.

parameter.name: buyRoute
parameter.description: The route the buying policy gives a buy conversion: order or request (P14b)

service.description: Keep the organization's one plan schedule (D20): the facility set it plans, every how many hours, the next run, the horizon (the production policy's when empty), whether it is active, and the organization's option to net held quantity whose inspection is due within the lead time (off by default), each change audit-logged with who made it. The run_ScheduledSupplyPlans job runs an active schedule when due, as the user who last kept it. Requires SUPPLY_PLAN_RUN (PERMISSION_DENIED); refuses an organization or facility outside the user's (RECORD_UNAVAILABLE) and an interval outside 1 to 744 hours or a horizon outside 1 to 730 days (SCHEDULE_INVALID).

Convert selected suggestions of a plan into supply, each suggestion a group in its own transaction with the operation key operationKey/suggestion, so one that fails is named with its reason and the others go on, and a retry answers each group's first result. A make suggestion becomes a draft run through mantle.work.ProductionServices.create#ProductionOrder (never released) for the requirement's remaining quantity, with the method as of methodDate (the plan date when empty), on the facility given or the routing's work center under the suggestion's facility, then RequirementSupply and WorkRequirementFulfillment WrfDelivers, the requirement Ordered. The requirement is locked first: one already covered answers its existing run (resultCode EXISTING), whoever covered it. An outside-processing suggestion (PsmOutside, impl-manufacturing P14: the requirement of mantle.work.ProductionServices.request#SubcontractService) becomes a line of a draft purchase order of its supplier, one order per supplier in this call: the service OrderItem at the requirement's remaining quantity and unit at the supplier's price (mantle.product.PriceServices.get#ProductPrice, the shared resolver, with the organization as buyer), its OrderItemWorkEffort to the operation (requiredWork Y), a RequirementSupply of the line, the requirement Ordered and the subcontract given the line; the order is never placed or approved (Purchasing's). Its plan's age does not matter (the quantity is the request's, not netted). A buy suggestion (impl-purchasing P14a) becomes a line of a draft purchase order of its supplier for its facility, one order per supplier and facility in this call (one purchase part), at the requirement's remaining quantity in the stock unit and the supplier's price, with a RequirementSupply of the line, the requirement Ordered; never placed or approved. A buy whose requirement another conversion already covered is refused DEMAND_ALREADY_COVERED, naming the supply, so no second order is made; a retry with the same operation key answers its first result (EXISTING). The buy's route (impl-purchasing P14b, SupplyPlanningRoutes.js): where the organization's buying policy sends plan buys to purchase requests (PurchasePolicy.planBuyToRequest), a buy suggestion becomes lines of a purchase request of the organization for its facility, one request per organization and facility in this call, sent to its approval (submit#PurchaseRequest) once the call's lines are in: a line per customer order line of the requirement with a RequestItemOrder to it, and one for the rest, each a RequirementSupply RstPurchaseRequest (an order route asked for under that policy is ROUTE_NOT_ALLOWED). With route dropShip (customer-order demand) each approved customer order line of the requirement moves to the supplier's drop-ship facility through mantle.order.DropShipServices.route#OrderItemToDropShip, which buys it, its purchase order line covering the requirement (NO_CUSTOMER_LINE without one; DROP_SHIP_PENDING when no line's order is approved yet); what is not covered stays to convert (PssPartial). Transfer suggestions are not converted here (METHOD_NOT_CONVERTED). An automatic conversion (automatic) leaves a suggestion whose reorder rule is snoozed (SUGGESTION_SNOOZED). Requires PRODUCTION_PLAN for make and PURCHASE_ORDER_EDIT for buy and outside processing (PERMISSION_DENIED); refuses a buy or outside-processing suggestion with no supplier (SUGGESTION_EXCEPTION) or no supplier price (PRICE_UNAVAILABLE), a product that cannot be bought (PRODUCT_NOT_USABLE), and a suggestion outside the user's organizations (RECORD_UNAVAILABLE), a stale plan (PLAN_STALE), an exception (SUGGESTION_EXCEPTION), a superseded or converted suggestion (SUGGESTION_CLOSED), a product that cannot be produced (PRODUCT_NOT_USABLE) and create#ProductionOrder's refusals.

parameter.name: facilityId
parameter.description: The facility of the runs, for every suggestion converted; each suggestion's own when empty.

parameter.name: automatic
parameter.description: A conversion no person chose (a schedule's or a policy's): a suggestion whose reorder rule is snoozed is left (SUGGESTION_SNOOZED).

parameter.name: route
parameter.description: A buy suggestion's route: dropShip (its customer order lines to the supplier's drop-ship facility), request or order; the buying policy's when empty (P14b).

parameter.name: supplierPartyId
parameter.description: The drop-ship route's supplier; each suggestion's own when empty.

parameter.name: results
parameter.description: Per suggestion: planningSuggestionId, ok, resultCode CREATED or EXISTING, requirementId, workEffortId, quantity and facilityId (make), or orderId and orderItemSeqId (buy and outside processing), requestId and requestItemSeqIds (the request route), route, routedLines and pendingLines (the drop-ship route), or reasonCode and message.

parameter.name: requests
parameter.description: The purchase requests the call made: requestId, submitted, statusId, and the message when it stayed a draft.

service.description: One group of convert#PlanningSuggestions: one suggestion, under its requirement's lock, with its own operation key; its checks and refusals are convert#PlanningSuggestions'.

parameter.name: orderId
parameter.description: Buy and outside processing: the draft order of the same supplier (and facility, for a buy) an earlier group of the call made, which this line joins

parameter.name: requestId
parameter.description: The request route: the draft purchase request of the same organization and facility an earlier group of the call made, which these lines join

parameter.name: route
parameter.description: A buy's route: order, request or dropShip; the policy's when empty
